feeds.title: Stadia Church Planting
feeds.description: STADIA helps great leaders start churches that intentionally care for children. We have a passionate desire to see a world where every child has a church.

feeds.title: Church Planting
feeds.description: Provides resources to help plant, strengthen and revitalize the local church. We aim to equip and encourage church planters. Bloggers on the site include a Who's Who list from the Church Planting World comprised of coaches and authors.

feeds.title: CBWC Church Planting
feeds.description: CBWC Church Planting aims at reaching people for Christ by seeking the health and extending the ministry of the local church.

feeds.title: Rohadi's Blog » Church Planting
feeds.description: This blog of Rohadi is all about Church planting. Rohadi is an author, speaker, developer, pastor and entrepreneur. Follow to keep up with the latest updates.

feeds.title: Union Church Blog
feeds.description: This blog belongs to Chris and Cara Jane, with a desire to see churches planted in college towns. Union Church is the result of a calling to plant a multiethnic church in a college town in the South. After walking toward this vision for many years, they are excited to finally be there and eager to watch the Lord work.

feeds.title: Dynamic Church Planting Intl Blog
feeds.description: Our mission is to find and train leaders to plant dynamic churches. We equip those leaders to teach others how to plant reproductive churches.

feeds.title: The Gospel Coalition » Church Planting
feeds.description: This blog of The Gospel Coalition (TGC) is all about Church planting. TGC is a coalition of Christ followers from around the world, banding together to renew the contemporary church in the ancient gospel.
